Override.AttributionNote: 五家語錄（選錄）, Linji Yixuan's encounter with Mayu Baoche. Linji Yixuan is the exact speaker of the stored reply: after Mayu asks which of Great Compassion's thousand hands and eyes is the true eye, Linji repeats the question and commands him to answer quickly.
